analysis.method: Node built-in lexical/structural Java scanner; no tree-sitter/compiler AST
analysis.tokenEstimate: ceil(UTF-8 bytes / 4); approximate, not a model tokenizer
analysis.compactSymbolPriority: non-private members before private; higher inbound reference count first; types before fields, then source line/name
limits: No method bodies/comments/literal values/field initializers are emitted.
Import/type graph is not a semantic call graph.
Named nested types are qualified under their enclosing type. Anonymous classes, lambda bodies, implicit/generated members, enum constants, and record components are not modeled as declarations.
Multiline and overloaded declarations are scanned structurally, but complex Java grammar, generic resolution, annotations, and ambiguous type names can still yield omissions or imperfect signatures.
